name: GitHub
author: Barynt
description: Your GitHub work on the issues it's about: each card shows its pull request with reviews and checks, the issue gets a Development panel with branch, commits and checks, rules move it to In Review or Done as the pull request opens and merges, and a branch starts right from the issue.

de.description: Deine GitHub-Arbeit an den Issues, um die es geht: Karten zeigen ihren Pull Request mit Reviews und Checks, das Issue ein Panel „Development“ mit Branch, Commits und Checks. Regeln setzen es auf In Review oder Done, wenn der Pull Request geöffnet oder gemergt wird. Branches entstehen im Issue.

notes.0.1.0-beta.1:
The first pre-release, for Barynt 1.1.0 and its betas.
- A pull request's row on the board cards it names
- The Development panel in an issue: branch, pull requests, checks, reviews, commits
- Rules: a pull request opened or merged sets the issue's status
- Create a branch, copy its name, open a pull request — from the issue
